$comment: Limits for models the player imports. Read by BOTH the headset's gatekeeper (Island.Core, work package I-01) and the browser converter (I-04), so a file the converter produces is one the headset will accept. Changing a number here changes both; do not fork it.

notes.whyTheHeadsetChecksAgain: The converter runs in the player's browser and can be bypassed by dropping a file straight into the imports folder. The headset is the trust boundary (ADR-12), so it checks everything again and trusts nothing the file says about itself.
notes.whyPerFileNotPerSubsystem: ADR-10 gives imported models 25 draws, 120K triangles and 128 MB in total. These are per-file limits sized so that a handful of models fits inside that, not so that one may fill it.
notes.unverified: Like every other budget in this project, these have never been measured on a Quest 2. They are deliberately conservative; the first device gate replaces them with readings.
